path.write_text('''def transform(grid):
 h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
 for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(pts):
  for r2,c2 in pts[i+1:]:
   dr=r2-r1; dc=c2-c1
   if dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc):
    steps=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
    sr=0 if dr==0 else dr//abs(dr); sc=0 if dc==0 else dc//abs(dc)
    for k in range(1,steps): out[r1+sr*k][c1+sc*k]=3
 return out
''')
